_comments: Sent by Orders.PollExternalPayments once per payment, on the pass that moves it into a state
waiting for a person, or from one such state to another (#1033). Payments already waiting are not
announced again, so the hourly poll no longer reports them as a failed run. Recipient: the poll
job's NotifyUserID, else its OwnerUserID, else the user running the poll.

fields.Name: Payment Needs Review
fields.Description: Sent when the external payment poll leaves a payment waiting for a person: unmatched to invoices Orders issued, refused, re-applied to different invoices on the rail, or needing reversal. One notice per payment when it starts waiting or its reason changes. Act on it under Orders → Receivables → Invoicing queue → Payment exceptions.
